meta.name: tfx-codex
meta.description: Codex-Only 오케스트레이터. tfx-auto 워크플로우를 Codex 전용으로 고정합니다.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把重复的开发流程限定为只通过Codex运行
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果希望开发工作流统一由Codex来跑
copy.tagline_en: Lock your automation workflows to run only through Codex
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want your dev workflows to exclusively use Codex

howto.what: 让Claude把tfx-auto的完整工作流程固定为只用Codex CLI跑外部任务：原本由Gemini负责的designer和writer分别改用Codex（生成UI代码）和Codex Spark（生成轻量文档），其余代理不变。适合没有Antigravity CLI的环境。
howto.when: 当你说出“/tfx-codex”并附上任务描述时触发，也可带“N:codex”前缀指定Codex模式。任务会走tfx-auto的1~6阶段流程。

say.text: /tfx-codex 帮我做一个登录页面的UI设计
/tfx-codex N:codex 写一份API接口说明文档
say.note: writer会用Codex Spark快速产出文档

say.text: /tfx-codex 排查并修复当前项目的编译错误

howto.what_en: Makes Claude run the full tfx-auto workflow using only Codex CLI for external tasks: the Gemini-based designer and writer are remapped to Codex (UI code) and Codex Spark (light docs); other agents unchanged. For environments without Antigravity CLI.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say "/tfx-codex" with a task description, optionally with an "N:codex" prefix. The task follows tfx-auto phases 1–6.

say_en.text: /tfx-codex Create a login page UI for me.
say_en.note: Designer generates UI code via Codex.

say_en.text: /tfx-codex N:codex Write an API reference doc.
say_en.note: Writer uses Codex Spark for light docs.

say_en.text: /tfx-codex Find and fix the build errors in this project.
say_en.note: Executor and build-fixer run on Codex.
